description:
Create a new Bundle Product in Magento named 'Ultimate Camping Kit' with SKU 'CAMP-BUNDLE-001'. 

Configuration:
- Dynamic Price: Yes
- Dynamic Weight: Yes
- Status: Enabled
- Visibility: Catalog, Search
- Category: Sports
- Ship Bundle Items: Together

Bundle Items (3 Options):

1. Title: 'Choose Your Tent'
   - Input Type: Radio Buttons
   - Required: Yes
   - Products: 'Basic 2-Person Tent' (Default), 'Family 4-Person Tent'

2. Title: 'Select Sleeping Gear'
   - Input Type: Drop-down
   - Required: Yes
   - Products: 'Lightweight Sleeping Bag' (Default), 'Winter Insulated Sleeping Bag'

3. Title: 'Add Camp Kitchen'
   - Input Type: Checkbox
   - Required: No
   - Products: 'Portable Camp Stove', 'Camp Cookware Set'

Note: The constituent simple products (tents, sleeping bags, stoves) have already been created for you. You just need to create the bundle and assign them.
